# AlphaIT Engineering

> Product engineering company that builds, deploys and licenses the systems businesses, institutions and governments run on. Operating across Kenya, Nigeria and the United Arab Emirates.

AlphaIT Engineering starts from a system it has already engineered, connects it to the tools and data an organisation already runs, and engineers only the capability that is still missing.

- Legal entity (contracting): Alpha Innovation Technologies - F.Z.C, Free Zone Company, Ajman Free Zone, United Arab Emirates. Licence and registration number 33549, first issued 31 January 2024.
- Legal entity (Nigeria): Alpha Innovation Technologies Ltd, CAC registration number 7450573, incorporated 17 April 2024.
- Founder and enterprise architect: Alpha Lucky Chukwunwike Okechukwu, who also founded LisBon Platforms and LisBonFARM.
- Locations: Ajman Free Zone, United Arab Emirates. Nairobi, Kenya. Lagos, Nigeria.
- Contact: projects@alphaitengineering.com
- Brand line: Product Engineering. Without Limits.

## Systems engineered by AlphaIT

- [Verdika](https://alphaitengineering.com/verdika): See what people experience. Fix what matters next. Experience intelligence and accountability. For: Businesses, institutions and public bodies that need to understand customer, employee or public experience.
- [Varren](https://alphaitengineering.com/varren): Tell Varren what needs to happen. Governed organisational execution. For: Organisations that need research, plans, content, approvals and authorised commercial action to work together.
- [Varren Aegis](https://alphaitengineering.com/varren-aegis): Attack your platform first. Prove the fix. Platform assurance. For: Teams responsible for live websites, platforms and digital services.
- [Varren Herald](https://alphaitengineering.com/varren-herald): Bring customers back with something true to say. Measured customer re-engagement. For: Service businesses and platform teams that want to bring customers back for a useful, timely reason.
- [LisBon Signal Infrastructure (LSI)](https://alphaitengineering.com/lisbon-signal): Make financial records trustworthy. Financial data-truth infrastructure. For: Banks, lenders, fintechs and teams that need reliable signals from financial records.
- [LisBon Trust Infrastructure (LTI)](https://alphaitengineering.com/lisbon-trust): Make every credit decision explainable. Trust and credit decision infrastructure. For: Banks, lenders, fintechs and capital providers assessing individuals, businesses or institutions.
- [LisCredit Marketplace](https://alphaitengineering.com/liscredit): Bring qualified demand and the right capital together. Credit marketplace infrastructure. For: Marketplace operators, banks, lenders, funds, fintechs and platforms that want to launch, embed or participate in a controlled credit marketplace.
- [Trust App](https://alphaitengineering.com/trust-app): Your bank statement, turned into trust. Consumer financial trust application. For: Lenders and institutions that need a clear financial-profile and credit-application journey for customers.
- [LisBon Flow Infrastructure (LFI)](https://alphaitengineering.com/lisbon-flow): Give recurring physical operations one operating truth. Route operations infrastructure. For: Transport, logistics and delivery businesses that want connected operations under their own brand.
- [Flow App](https://alphaitengineering.com/flow-app): Run work on the move from one operating view. Operations application. For: Transport and logistics businesses that need a connected booking and service experience for customers and drivers.
- [Pollenair](https://alphaitengineering.com/pollenair): Make practical learning and capability visible. Practical capability infrastructure. For: Institutions, employers and sponsors running practical skills programmes.
- [Focused AlphaIT Build](https://alphaitengineering.com/business-systems-engineering): Engineer the missing system behind your next opportunity. Focused product engineering. For: Organisations whose service, process or new offering cannot be served fully by an existing system.

## Related platforms founded by Alpha Lucky Chukwunwike Okechukwu

- LisBon Platforms (https://lisbonplatforms.com): multi-sector infrastructure group. AlphaIT engineers the LisBon products; LisBon Platforms owns and operates them.
- LisBonFARM (https://lisbonfarm.com): agro-industrial infrastructure platform, sponsor of AgroGlobal ICPI in Edo State, Nigeria.
- Verdika (https://verdika.co): the live public application of the Verdika experience and accountability platform.

## What AlphaIT does not claim

- Deployment scope, integrations, data permissions, timing and commercial terms are agreed per organisation and are not published.
- Product measures are what a deployment can make visible, not guaranteed results.
- AlphaIT builds, hosts and licenses these systems. It does not operate them on its own behalf, so it publishes no usage figures of its own.
